the number of editors affects article quality only when the editors coordinate effectively, that implicit coordination (i.e., a small number of editors concentrating the work) is most helpful when there are many contributors and explicit coordination (i.e. communication) is not, and that both types of coordination are more helpful when articles are in a formative state.
Adding more editors improves article quality only if they use appropriate coordination techniques and is harmful if they do not.
